subject: Request: Pricing floor override for HealthSync pilot — VP/CFO signoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: HealthSync pilot pricing ask — need VP/CFO signoff

Markus / Marissa / Kim —

Quick summary: HealthSync is asking for a pilot price well below our published entry floor to accommodate their federated deployment and high embedding volume. They are a strategic prospect (HS platform integration; potential multi-year expansion). Current ask: 60% off list for the first 6 months on Hosted API + waived VPC onboarding fee.

Why this is unusual:
- Volume mix heavily skewed to embeddings (expected 70% of tokens) which lowers per-token revenue.
- They want replacement of our Dedicated upsell language for a soft commitment (no hard annual minimum).

Attached: healthsync-deal-summary.xlsx (usage forecast, ARR math).

Asking: can we get VP/CFO signoff to approve a temporary pricing floor override for the pilot and a one-time waived onboarding fee? If yes, I will present the term sheet and ask legal to prepare a limited pilot addendum.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Quick decision on override (yes/no + guardrails).
2) If yes, Kim/Finance: confirm tolerance on unit economics and any revenue protection (true-up clause).
3) Legal: limited-term addendum to protect us.

Thanks — I can hop on a call this morning if useful.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: HealthSync pilot pricing ask — need VP/CFO signoff

Markus / Kim —

Attaching a concise internal memo that covers the commercial rationale, margin impact, and suggested guardrails. See pricing-exception-memo-healthsync-20261028.pdf attached. Highlights below:

- Commercial rationale: HealthSync fits target profile for platform partners (strategic Cloud partner interest in our private offering next quarter). Positive reference value and likely expansion into Dedicated within 9–12 months.
- Financials: projected pilot ARR (first 6 months at proposed price) = $42k; NPV at our target discount rate negative vs baseline, but expansion probability drives expected long-term ARR of $520k over 3 years.
- Suggested guardrails:
  • Limit pilot to 6 months with defined true-up if usage > agreed ramp.
  • Cap the waived onboarding fee to a one-time credit recoverable if they convert to Dedicated within 12 months.
  • Require limited data retention terms and audit access for billing verification.

Please review the memo and confirm if you’re comfortable signing off. If you prefer, I can add a short finance appendix with per-token margin calculations.

Thanks — I will stand by for signoff to route to Legal (Mina).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Internal memo and term-sheet (attached) — HealthSync pilot exception request

Team —

Attaching the formal internal pricing-exception-memo-healthsync-20261028.pdf and a draft term sheet (redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf). Key ask: VP/CFO signoff on the pilot pricing override and approval to send draft terms to HealthSync next week.

Internal memo (excerpt):
- Deal snapshot: HealthSync (B2B healthcare analytics), 6-month pilot, expected monthly token consumption: 120M tokens (70% embeddings).
- Proposed commercial terms:
  • Pilot price: 60% off hosted list for tokens; waive one-time VPC onboarding fee ($25k) as credit.
  • Usage true-up: if average monthly usage exceeds projected ramp by >30%, revert to standard pricing and invoice difference retroactively.
  • Conversion incentive: if they commit to Dedicated within 12 months, onboarding fee credit converts to a $15k implementation credit on Dedicated contract.
- Risk mitigation: 3-month checkpoint with finance to review actual unit economics.

Financial appendix included in the attached spreadsheet. I ran Redwood Optimize's suggested batching/kv-cache settings and included expected cost delta — roughly +18% marginal cost vs baseline because of embedding-heavy mix.

Please reply here with APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS / DENY. If APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS, list them concisely so I can incorporate into the term sheet.

Attachments: pricing-exception-memo-healthsync-20261028.pdf, redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf, healthsync-deal-summary.xlsx

—Marissa

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal memo and term-sheet (attached) — HealthSync pilot exception request

Thanks for the memo — clear and helpful. A few quick questions before I move to signoff:

1) Can Finance (Kim) confirm worst-case cash flow and the break-even usage threshold if they never convert? I want the payback horizon spelled out (months) and downside exposure capped.
2) Mina — legal: include a 30-day audit window and explicit misuse language in the pilot addendum. Also confirm that the true-up mechanics are enforceable under our standard terms.
3) Sales ops / Aditya: confirm that there is no precedent risk to other active pilots (list any active exceptions).

If answers are satisfactory, I'm prepared to sign off with the following condition: add a 6-month revenue safety-net where 25% of waived onboarding credit is held as a refundable escrow against gross overage for the pilot period.

Please respond by EOD today; HealthSync is asking to finalize terms next Tuesday.

—Markus
Markus Klein | VP, Commercial
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal memo and term-sheet (attached) — HealthSync pilot exception request

All —

I reviewed the memo and the attached financial appendix. I will APPROVE the pilot pricing override subject to the following firm conditions:

1) True-up clause must be operational and clearly actionable: if usage exceeds projections by >30% in any rolling 30-day window we invoice the delta at standard rates retroactively.
2) 25% refundable escrow applied to waived onboarding credit; escrow released pro-rata over pilot term unless a true-up is triggered.
3) Legal (Mina) to confirm enforceability and add an explicit audit clause with narrow scope and notice periods.
4) Sales must present a one-paragraph precedent memo documenting why this is an exception and how similar requests will be handled in future (saved to the deals playbook).

Markus — you have my signoff to proceed to external with the updated term sheet once Legal confirms language. Marissa / Aditya: do not share the draft with HealthSync until Mina confirms.

Kim
Kimberly Park | Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
